description: Set up environment: install mummy HTTP library, configure nim.cfg for threading/ORC, verify existing 259 tests still pass with new compiler flags.
steps: Run: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nimble install mummy -y to install the HTTP library
If mummy install fails, note the error and plan to use std/asynchttpserver as fallback
Update nim.cfg to add --threads:on and --mm:orc flags needed by mummy. Current content is just --path:"/root/.choosenim/toolchains/nim-2.2.10/pkgs/db_connector/src"

Verify all existing tests still pass: nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_lexer.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_parser.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_integration.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_schema.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_query.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_migrations.nim
If tests fail with ORC/threads flags, adjust nim.cfg to only apply threading to specific compilation targets, or fix the issues
acceptance_criteria: mummy package is installed and importable (or fallback to std/asynchttpserver is documented)
nim.cfg has correct compiler flags for mummy compatibility
All 259 existing tests pass without regression
verification: Run: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_lexer.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_parser.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_integration.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_schema.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_query.nim && nim c --hints:off -r tests/test_migrations.nim
Run: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c --threads:on --mm:orc --hints:off -r tests/test_lexer.nim (verify threading works with existing tests)
findings: mummy HTTP library could not be installed - the GitHub gateway proxy does not have access to guzba/mummy repository. Falling back to std/asynchttpserver (stdlib). nim.cfg updated with --threads:on and --mm:orc globally. All 259 existing tests pass without regression with these new compiler flags. std/asynchttpserver imports and works correctly. doot.nimble documents the mummy dependency as commented-out with fallback note.
